headline: Robbins LLP Reminds Investors the Securities Fraud Class Action Against Alarum Technologies Ltd. Folling a 51.9 % Stock Drop on July 6, 2026
summary: Robbins LLP has filed a securities class action against Alarum Technologies Ltd. (NASDAQ: ALAR) on behalf of investors who purchased shares between March 20, 2025 and July 2, 2026.
